newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC splits stock two-for-one via dividend.
newsitem.headline: CIBC splits stock two-for-one via dividend.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that it set a two-for-one stock split through its dividends.

Canada's second largest bank said it declared a 100 percent stock dividend which will be paid on March 27, 1997, to common shareholders of record as of March 27, 1997 and the number of shares outstanding will double.

The bank said its board of directors also declared a dividend of C$0.25 cents a share on common shares for the quarter ending April 30, 1997, payable on April 28, 1997, to holders of record as of March 27, 1997.
The bank said the dividend is equivalent to the pre-split quarterly dividend rate of C$0.50 a share.
Other dividends for the quarter ending April 30, 1997, payable on April 28, 1997, to holders of record as of March 27, 1997, were declared as follows:
Dividends on Class A Series 4 and 5 will be paid in accordance with the terms of the series and on the dates specified.
